description: ONS: Carga de Energia Diária, published by Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS), reports daily electricity demand by Brazilian subsystem. Coverage: The product covers Brazil's interconnected electricity system, with the aggregation and equipment thresholds in its definition. Temporal resolution: daily. Coverage: Not established from metadata; consult dated resource entries. The linked ONS CKAN API identifies the product and its downloadable formats. Observation files and attached data dictionaries were not downloaded. The provider labels the product Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY), without a version in the reviewed metadata. Public metadata access required no registration; attribution and change disclosure remain applicable. Limitations: The load definition changes in March 2021 to add forecast non-dispatched generation and on 29 April 2023 to include estimated distributed micro- and mini-generation. Preserve these breaks in comparisons. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, network flow studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
